functions.note: 1.11.2 adds the centred rebuild for a narrower size and moves a wider one on the server; the player's sizes (0.6F standing, sneaking, fall flying; set_pose_height only changes the height) never narrow or widen it on the client, so both releases take the corner rebuild minX + width (the float field), minY + height, which set_pose_height makes on a changed height

refreshDimensions takes setBounds' place with the same corner rebuild (1.14.4 Entity.java:2260-2261: lv4.minX + lv3.width, lv4.minY + lv3.height, the float width) for a size that does not narrow, which the player's never does; it runs on a changed pose, which for set_pose_height is a changed height, as setBounds ran on a changed size. 1.16.5 walk/sneak_br t=20 records maxX = minX + 0.6F exactly after the pose update

from 1.17 refreshDimensions makes the box again from the position (reapplyPosition) instead of from the kept box's corner; the engine keeps no box from 1.17 (the tick sets state.bounding_box to None there, simulation.rs tick_with_rules: `(!rules.release.at_least(1, 17, 0)).then(...)`), so set_pose_height only sets the height and the box is the one around the position, as reapplyPosition makes it
